'''Lanteeban rats''' were rodent-like creatures that were native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lanteeb/Legends|Lanteeb]]. During the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] rule on Lanteeb, the Separatists were known to blast them for sport.<ref name="Clone Wars Gambit: Stealth">[[Clone Wars Gambit: Stealth]]</ref>
